However, you can always rejoin Qmee and start earning rewards again. ### How to Rejoin Qmee After Deleting Your Account If you change your mind and want to rejoin Qmee, simply download the Qmee app and create a new account. You can use the same email address and phone number as before, but you'll need to verify your account through the app. ### Tips for Deleting Your Qmee Account Before deleting your Qmee account, make sure you've: * Earned all your outstanding rewards * Redeemed any rewards you've earned * Closed any outstanding offers * Removed your payment information By following these steps, you'll be able to delete your Qmee account securely and easily.
